html: Every page now carries schema.org structured data (JSON-LD) built from the repository's own data: the home page as a WebSite and Organization; the registry and the question bank as a Dataset with their licences, versions and the JSON, CSV and PDF downloads; each instrument page as a WebPage about the instrument with its cited studies; the specification as a TechArticle with its version and status; the code lists as DefinedTermSets; and a breadcrumb trail on every page but the home page. Dates are the dates the repository records, and a page that records none carries none. A check in CI refuses malformed or stale JSON-LD.
